title: Serve embedded static assets via rust-embed
description: Wire up rust-embed to serve static assets from ui/ directory. Add routes for / (index.html) and /assets/* (CSS, JS). Implement SPA-aware fallback: unknown non-API routes serve index.html, API/health/ingest routes preserve JSON 404.
acceptance_criteria: Non-API unknown routes (e.g. /hooks/abc) serve index.html for SPA routing
API unknown routes (e.g. /api/nonexistent) still return JSON 404
